articles.제목: Industry urges nuclear recognition in COP31's 35-by-35 pledge
articles.원문 요약: The role that nuclear can play in achieving the COP31 summit's pledge to increase electricity to 35% of energy demand by 2035 should be acknowledged, industry leaders have said, with nuclear construction at a 40-year high.

articles.제목: Centrus, Oklo deal secures fuel for Ohio reactor deployment
articles.원문 요약: Centrus and Oklo have finalised agreements securing fuel to power up to five Aurora powerhouses for multiple years at a 1.2 GW Ohio campus for tech giant Meta, an agreement which helps Centrus's capacity expansion plans.

articles.제목: Strength and leak tests completed for Akkuyu 1 containment
articles.원문 요약: The air pressure was increased during pre-launch tests, which lasted eight days, to check the strength and leak tightness of the internal containment building for Akkuyu nuclear power plant's first unit.
